subject.title: feat: add plugin sdk deprecation baseline metadata

question: Should OpenClaw treat `deprecated` and `deprecatedMembers` as supported fields in the generated Plugin SDK API baseline consumed by downstream tooling?
rationale: The scoped Plugin SDK guide treats this area as a public plugin contract, and the PR changes generated record shape rather than only internal implementation.

options.title: Approve Schema Then Refresh
options.body: Approve the additive metadata shape, then require the author to rebase, replace the two `sort()` calls, and regenerate the baseline hash before merge.

options.title: Revise Metadata Contract
options.body: Ask for a narrower or differently shaped metadata contract if plugin-inspector needs different semantics or rollout behavior.

options.title: Pause Baseline Expansion
options.body: Keep the PR paused if maintainers are not ready to publish deprecation metadata through the generated Plugin SDK baseline.

recommendation.title: Approve Schema Then Refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the additive metadata shape, then require the author to rebase, replace the two `sort()` calls, and regenerate the baseline hash before merge.
